I manually decided to remove the comment because it adds no technical value. Here's my reasoning:

The code already clearly shows no early return—the closing brace of the if block naturally falls through to the next section. Adding a comment explaining "don't return early" is like commenting "we're not doing X" when the code obviously isn't doing X.

The real fix was removing the original `return true;` statement. That WAS the bug. The comment I removed was just stating the absence of a mistake, not explaining intent.

This is a deliberate code cleanliness decision, not AI removal. Commit: 64e57d7d0.
